{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]

# Count how many times each patient_id appears
dup_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
retest_patients = dup_counts[dup_counts > 1]

print(f'Number of patients with multiple records: {len(retest_patients)}')
print(f'Number of duplicate rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}')
print(f'Patient IDs with multiple records: {retest_patients.index.tolist()}')"}
